title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP in Colombia is implemented by partners Colombia Diversa, CCAJAR, Corambiente, PBI, Sisma Mujer and CCALCP, ABColombia, and CCEEU. Land and human rights defenders, women and marginalised groups are supported to take action to claim their rights, including under provisions of the 2016 Peace Agreement and to engage with power holders to advance peace, gender equality, climate justice and human rights in line with national and international frameworks. Partners work on environmental, land issues and climate change in Santander and Norte de Santander, La Guajira, Cauca and Valle del Cauca and the Magdalena Medio region; on gender equality and social inclusion in Santander, Norte de Santander, the Magdalena Medio region and nationally. In 2025, ICSP partners action and advocacy gave rise to two humanitarian caravans in Catatumbo; a humanitarian mission in Cauca and significant decisions made by ordinary and transitional justice systems (JEP). Women, particularly survivors of SGBV, were central actors in macro cases before the JEP, providing essential contribution to design litigation strategies, document the crimes they endured, and in proposing comprehensive reparation measures tailored to their needs. The programme reached 2,088 people directly (64% women) and 275,351 people indirectly in 2025..
